question.prompt: In a pie chart, a category accounts for 25% of the total. What is its corresponding central angle in degrees? If this category contains 30 people, what is the total number of people? (Answer in order, separated by a comma; write only numbers.)

solutions.explanation: Central angle \(=25\%\times360^\circ=90^\circ\); total number of people \(=30\div25\%=120\) (people).
solutions.title: Use the given percentage
